rv.q: MILLIONS is a heartwarming, beautifully told new musical that explores themes of innocence, generosity, and the moral complexities of sudden wealth.
In it Tony Award winner Adam Guettel has delivered another gorgeous score, and award-winning writer Bob Martin has brought the book up to date by moving the story to present-day Albuquerque.
The children onstage enrich the material the most.
But there’s something missing in the overall tone and look that right now isn’t there yet— and perhaps more challenging to pin down.

cn.t: Critics praise "Millions" for Adam Guettel's gorgeous score and strong performances, finding the new musical a rich and engaging world premiere that successfully brings its heartfelt story to life.
